summary:
Billing finally spoke in numbers; everything else stayed silent, and so did the client. Of the 10 messages this window, 7 were Stephski on 10-01 and 1 was Melissa's agency-wide intake-form broadcast (09-28). Stephski issued the Sep 15-30 invoice on schedule and, for the first time in eight billing cycles, stated the credit as a figure: 'we rolled over -$3,537.95 from your over payment from last month and the $1,500.00 we received on the 28th' / 'which totals the $5,037.95 we deducted from the invoice'. That implicitly confirms the 09-16 $10,000 landed (it produced the $3,537.95 overpayment) and the first 09-24 $1,500 wire arrived ('recieved this!'). But the SECOND 09-24 wire (sender Jose M Munoz Linss, amount visible only in a receipt photo) is missing at day 7: 'not seeing this one i double checked just now'. Liza now has to chase it herself: 'I’m checking on it'.

Nobody else from ALTR posted at all. Her 09-24 question 'What exactly you need , reels/ picks?' and her delivered customs ('All done ☑️') are now 8 days unanswered, two full windows. Ronnie, Mica, Mayson, Michelle, Vivek and Derrek sent nothing. ALTR's leak of her plaintext IG password (her 08-31 post, re-posted by Michelle 09-12, password [REDACTED]) is still in the room, still untold, 32 days on. Vivek: 32 days silent on three deleted IG accounts. Derrek: 59 days silent; the $5,000 under-credit is 23 days unacknowledged. Melissa's 09-25 weekly leak-removal update did not reach this chat, so DMCA output here is still zero since 2026-03-04.

CHURN WATCH: signal (a) is now present. After 17 messages met with silence last window, Liza sent nothing for 7 days, then only two short replies to billing ('Hi love 🤍', 'I’m checking on it'). She ignored the intake form. Signal (b) carries over: unprompted pre-invoice wires 'Towards next month commission' with zero service asks. No signals (c) or (d). The 09-25 report's trigger has fired: a second window closed with her 09-24 service messages unanswered. Treat the account as actively at risk despite flawless payment conduct and a still-warm tone.

health.rationale: Down 3 from 48. One real improvement: Stephski posted an explicit credit figure ($3,537.95 + $1,500 = $5,037.95) for the first time in eight cycles, confirmed one of the 09-24 wires, issued the Sep 15-30 invoice on time, and by implication closed the 9-day-old $10,000 clearance question. That is worth points on payment risk. It is outweighed by service failure and a new churn signal. For the second window running, nobody answered the client's 09-24 content question or acknowledged her delivered customs (8 days). The only non-billing ALTR message was a generic intake-form broadcast, which she ignored. Her own output fell from 17 messages to 2, both short billing replies, after 7 days of silence. That is churn signal (a), quiet/short, on top of signal (b) from last window: unprompted pre-invoice wires with zero asks. A second 09-24 wire is unaccounted for at day 7 and she is chasing it. Standing ALTR-caused risks are unchanged and still ageing: the plaintext-password leak (32 days, untold, and she said she would 'double check on this log in'), three deleted IG accounts with no status (Vivek 32 days silent), owner silence 59 days, $5,000 error unacknowledged 23 days. Held up only by her payment reliability and warm tone ('Hi love 🤍').
